slot_note: seed AD03 re-rooted, architecture 2: v1 (revenue protection, screen grain) was spent at in-house round 1; the objective and number are kept and the draw is new
niche: a New Zealand lines company's zone-substation transformer fleet, choosing which three transformers get the 2027/28 internal inspection outages from five years of dissolved gas analysis
stakeholder_role: network asset manager at a lines company, who takes the inspection slate to the board with the 2027/28 capital works programme

spine.entity: one laboratory dissolved gas analysis of one main-tank oil sample from one transformer

world.org_type: electricity distribution business (lines company) with 44 zone-substation power transformers

driver: A monitored signal that the standard reads as the unit's own fault can be carried in from an attached compartment whose ordinary operation produces it, so ranking units on the signal measured in the main body puts units with a leaking neighbour ahead of units with genuine internal faults; only attributing each unit's signal to its source, by its co-movement with the neighbour's operations and its composition, separates them.
driver_concrete: Acetylene in a transformer's main-tank oil reads as arcing and the fleet DGA standard codes it most severely; at two zone substations with in-oil arcing tap changers the barrier between the tap-changer compartment and the main tank leaks, so their main-tank acetylene rises with every tap change and their code-3 severity leads the fleet, while a third transformer with a vacuum tap changer carries the same acetylene from a genuine internal arc; a slate built on main-tank codes spends two of its three outages on tap-changer seals.
stump: A competent solver codes every transformer under the fleet DGA standard from its main-tank samples (limits by preservation type and age, twelve-month rates, condition code 3 ranked by severity) and names the three highest code-3 units, two of which carry acetylene leaked from in-oil tap-changer compartments; the step that lands it there is reading main-tank acetylene as a main-tank fault, when its increments track each unit's tap-change counts and its ratio to hydrogen is the tap changer's, so the slate should take the vacuum-tap-changer unit and the next two internal faults.

lineage.architecture: v1 (screen grain: metering system against supply number)
lineage.fate: spent at in-house solver round 1 (2026-10-11): plain 81.3 and skeptic 85.6, both landed Caithness 54; the filed glossary and the related metering points sheet made the grain a work order
lineage.driver: The referral test is filed for each metered sub-unit against its own history, but the ready-made series sums the sub-units of an entity, and where an entity holds a second sub-unit carrying one seasonal load, a large fall on that sub-unit moves the entity total by a few per cent, inside ordinary variation, so screening the summed series ranks the candidates differently from screening each sub-unit and counting entities once.

notes: Re-root of task180 (architecture 2). Subdomain asset-condition-maintenance carried under Anomaly Detection & Diagnostics because DGA interpretation is fault diagnosis on condition-monitoring anomalies. Bespoke draw from how zone-substation transformers are built (in-oil arcing tap changers in a compartment sharing a barrier with the main tank on older units, vacuum tap changers on newer ones) and monitored (main-tank DGA on a schedule, compartment samples less often, tap-change counters on SCADA). No calibration corpus, no licensed wrong basis; the fleet DGA standard is filed in full and says nothing about compartment leakage.
layer1: laboratory DGA reports with sampling and analysis dates, below-detection values written as <n, and O2 and N2 for the preservation type
an asset register with rewind years and tap-changer types by make and model
SCADA daily tap-change counters that roll over at 99,999 and reset when a counter is replaced at tap-changer maintenance
a maintenance log in free text with oil processing, tap-changer services and seal work
a mobile substation booking schedule for the 2027/28 outages
